sql: WITH w AS (SELECT m.conversation_id AS id FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = c.instance_id WHERE c.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND m.timestamp > now() - interval '30 hours' AND (m.content ILIKE '%unidade%' OR m.content ILIKE '%outro endere%' OR m.content ILIKE '%outro sal%' OR m.content ILIKE '%campolim%') GROUP BY m.conversation_id) SELECT c.contact_name, i.unit, m.timestamp, (CASE WHEN m.from_me THEN 'EU[' || coalesce(m.metadata->>'source', '-') || ']: ' ELSE 'CLIENTE: ' END) || left(coalesce(m.content, m.message_type), 900) AS txt FROM wapi_messages m JOIN w ON m.conversation_id = w.id JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = c.instance_id WHERE m.timestamp > now() - interval '3 days' ORDER BY c.contact_name, m.timestamp
